text: APPROVE. `JudgeAsync` is now a flat sequence of about 10 early-return checks plus two ternaries, well under 15, and every extracted step keeps the original check order, verdict outcomes and reason strings, and passes the same `suite`, `delta`, `units` and `items` into each verdict. The one thing I could not check is the unchanged hermetic-guards lines between the two hunks, since the diff doesn't show them, so I couldn't confirm they don't use a local that no longer exists in `EngineTestsStopAsync`.
